Alex — thanks for the packet, that helps a lot.

Quick checklist from our side to complete the vendor profile and route POs correctly:

1) W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) signed by authorized signer
2) Bank account details for ACH (account number + routing) or instructions for wire payments
3) Legal entity name exactly as filed (you provided this; we'll mirror it)
4) Billing / remittance address (confirmed above)
5) Primary PO contact and a backup PO contact

I attached our internal vendor-setup-template.xlsx for the fields we import into the registry — feel free to populate the bank info there and send back or paste the details into your reply if easier.

Estimated timeline: once we have W-9 + bank details, we can create the vendor record within 1 business day and route POs to 'ProcureOps' by default; the first live PO typically follows within 2 business days after record activation. If you need expedited routing for an immediate order let me know and I can flag it.

Also looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (tax/contract) to confirm no additional documents are required for your entity type.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-setup-template.xlsx (Excel, form)
